notes.title: Steam Next Fest : live demo gameplay !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291227/11b50786469748800fe82a4773f6f9aebe07f7d8.png[/img]

Join us on June the 15th at 7pm (Paris time) to take a look under the hood of the demo with the team behind Cleromancy. Combat tactics, rare events, secret interactions, we’ll show you as much as we can !

It’s also a great opportunity for you to ask us anything. What’s next for Cleromancy ? What is it like to develop a game ? How will we achieve world domination ? What are our artistic references ? If you’re curious about any of this, feel free to check out the stream.

See you soon !

notes.title: Steam Next Fest : speedrun, challenges and designs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291227/11b50786469748800fe82a4773f6f9aebe07f7d8.png[/img]

Join us on June the 17th at 7pm (Paris time) to witness the demo beeing pushed to its limits by the dev team ! Stay with us until the end to catch a glimpse of what’s to come for future designs.

As always, it’s a good opportunity for you to ask us anything. How do we generate the environments ? Who is our favourite character ? How many hens are we raising ? How long is our code ? So many questions and many more if you just turn up to ask them.

See you soon !

notes.title: Cleromancy has launched on Kickstarter !
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=KyH5GBfNd6A;full][/previewyoutube]

Here we go ! Cleromancy will be on Kickstarter for the next 28 days, with a simple goal in mind : raise enough to keep developing in the best conditions possible and dish out a game we can be proud of. Of course, it’s also an opportunity for you to grab the game for a lower price compared to launch day, as well as other goodies if anythign catches your eye !

I invite you to try out the demo, forge your own opinion of the game, and drop by the Kickstarter page if you had a good time : [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/remi-indefini/cleromancy]it’s right here.[/url]

We will keep updating the demo along the next few weeks to enhance it and fix bugs until we’re staisfied with it. Stay tuned !

Thanks for giving us a try, and see you soon !
